name: Twizzlers Strawberry Licorice Twists
whyItWorks: Twizzlers are formulated from enriched wheat flour, corn syrup, and sugar with less than 0.5g fat and 0g fiber. They provide satisfying chewy sweetness without chocolate, seeds, dairy, or nuts.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Pull twists apart and chew thoroughly. A reliable cinema or road trip sweet for IBD patients.
watchOuts: Contains wheat flour; not suitable for individuals with celiac disease.
